newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see tight EU hipro soymeal supplies.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see tight EU hipro soymeal supplies.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw November EU high protein soymeal changing hands at a $7 premium over December due to tight nearby supplies, market sources said.
Nov hipro soymeal traded at $301 a tonne fob Rotterdam, Dec unchanged at $294 and Jan at $287 a tonne fob.

"Due to late arrivals of soybeans crushers in Europe can't run at full capacity, but there is no panic amongst buyers. If you need prompt material you have to pay more," one broker said, adding that new crop beans were excpected within a couple of weeks.
Otherwise the European market faced a dull day due to lack of fresh market moving news and a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening.
Arrived Argentine soymeal traded at $265 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Oct Brazilian soymeal pellets at $282.50 a tonne cif.
Spot Thai hard tapioca pellets fetched 21 marks per 100 kg fob Ghent and arrived material 20.25 marks fob Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
